purpose: Bind each human language/content review to one exact source file and a trusted reviewer key.

review_attestation.path: relative path below the corpus manifest directory

attestation_fields.source_sha256: SHA-256 recomputed from the corpus-local source file
attestation_fields.reviewer_id: stable reviewer identifier present in the separately trusted roster
attestation_fields.review_notes: At least 20 characters describing the actual review
attestation_fields.issue_log: array; empty means no issues found, non-empty records concrete issues

signature.signed_payload: UTF-8 canonical JSON of all attestation fields except signature; keys sorted, separators comma/colon, ensure_ascii false
signature.path: relative path below the corpus manifest directory
signature.sha256: 64 lowercase hex characters of the detached signature file

trusted_reviewer_roster.location: separate file, not embedded in the corpus manifest
trusted_reviewer_roster.sha256_pin: must be supplied independently to the verifier

reviewers.public_key_path: relative path below roster file directory
